hero.label: Full-Stack Web Developer
hero.description: Career-changer turned developer, trained at École 42 Paris. I build robust web applications and polished interfaces — currently on a full-stack internship in Toulouse.

about.p1: I transitioned into development after discovering my passion for solving complex problems. I joined École 42 Paris where I learned to code in C/C++ through projects, with total autonomy.
about.p2_pre: Now on a full-stack internship at
about.p2_post: , I'm building an internal portal from scratch with React, TypeScript and Laravel — with a constant focus on code quality and architecture.
about.p3_pre: What drives me: understanding systems deeply, writing maintainable code, and building interfaces that
about.p3_em: make people want to use them.
about.location: Based in Toulouse — open to remote & relocation

japan-awaits.title: Japan Awaits — Internal Portal
japan-awaits.tagline: Full rebuild of a custom travel management portal
japan-awaits.description: Complete overhaul of Japan Awaits' internal portal: booking management, guide tracking, expenses, electronic contracts and dashboards. React + Inertia.js + Laravel architecture, with a strong focus on separation of concerns.

transcendence.title: ft_transcendence
transcendence.tagline: École 42 final project — full-featured multiplayer Pong game
transcendence.description: End-of-curriculum project at École 42, built as a team of 4. Real-time Pong game with authentication, user profiles, tournaments, live chat and full Docker deployment.

timequest.title: TimeQuest
timequest.tagline: Mobile game — guess the date of historical events
timequest.description: Mobile quiz app where players race to estimate the date of iconic historical events. Playable solo or multiplayer. Personal project built as a duo.

biscotte.title: Biscotte
biscotte.tagline: Mobile app for personal recipe management
biscotte.description: Mobile app to create, organize and find your recipes. Local SQLite storage, polished UI, ingredient management, preparation steps and photos. Personal project in progress.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.tagline: This site — designed and built from scratch
portfolio.description: Personal portfolio built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. High-end design with scroll-driven animations, custom cursor, dark/light mode and FR/EN bilingual support.
highlights: FR/EN i18n system with JSON files
Consistent design system with CSS variables
